subject: general
question:
What would be the letter on the opposite side of 'R' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7476b2799471d510260a2fb5dc1fd271490d53be96a0c7b23766fc42897afef2.png]
solution: Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below methods: - • Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other. • No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners. So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.
